title: AgentDefinition
description: Versioned agent definition created, edited, tested and published in NexChat (owner: apps/chat; URI nexus://agent/<id>). NexCore never authors definitions — it attaches a governance record (core.agent_governance: review / block) that the PEP enforces on invoke. Runtime = PydanticAI AgentRuntime. Tool/skill/model bindings are references — the PEP re-checks them at run time.

project_id.description: Owning Project when project-scoped; absent = workspace-level.

tools.description: ToolBindings owned by this agent. Replaces `tool_refs` (UAT-2c). Only a human author binds tools — an agent never grants itself capabilities; CapabilityRequests add bindings after approval.

a2a_agent_refs.description: Other agents this agent may delegate to over A2A (nexus://agent/<id>).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the agent's structured answer must satisfy.

graph_scope.description: Verified Domain-graph scope the agent may ground in (e.g. project | domain:procurement).

memory_policy.description: none | project | thread — what the agent may remember across turns (policy-gated).

permissions.description: Upper bound the agent may operate under; runtime permission is always the intersection with the invoking user's rights.

model_preference.description: Composer default (D26). Since `inference` is the canonical requirement; preferred_model_id is a Developer-mode pin.

governance.description: Read-only projection of the NexCore governance record. `blocked` ⇒ PEP denies invoke/publish; UI shows compact deny via user_message_key.

intent.description: AI-first creation: the natural-language intent the draft was generated from.

resolver_run.description: 1.88.0: the Auto resolver run that drafted this agent on the person's behalf — publish stays the person's; the publish writes `draft_published` to that run's plan decision.

inference.description: Role-based model requirement. Preferred over model_id; when both are present the validator warns model_id_pinned and the runtime honours `inference`.

capability.description: 1.25.0: declared ROUTING metadata the capability catalog read model projects into a RoutableCapability. Authored by a human in Studio; absent block → derived defaults (`intents = []`, `side_effects` from tool bindings / requires). Never read by the runtime; never a permission.

routable.description: 1.76.0: false ⇒ the capability catalog never projects this agent — Auto never ranks it. For agents a pack ships only as steps of its own Flows. Absent = true. Not a permission, not a picker rule.
